# postgres dependency

Source: https://github.com/porsager/postgres
Package: `postgres@3.4.7`, released into the public domain under the Unlicense.

## Why this notice is retained here

The Unlicense is a public-domain dedication and requires no attribution, so
nothing here is obligatory. It is retained because the published npm tarball
carries no license text of any kind - no license file, and no mention in the
README - which leaves an installed tree stating a license it does not contain.

Recording the dedication makes the tree self-describing rather than leaving a
reader to take the manifest's word for it. Retained verbatim in UNLICENSE from
the upstream repository, fetched 2026-09-12.

Exact package and transitive integrity hashes are in `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
